data.body:
[P2] Include the new regressions in cloud integration

`jest.config.integration.js` filters test names with `testNamePattern: "cloud"`, so this suite and the new early-completion-suspends and concurrency-slot-held-until-settled suites are skipped entirely. They also instantiate `LocalDurableTestRunner` directly, leaving their deployed SAM functions untested. Consequently, these regressions do not verify checkpoint history or suspension against the real Lambda service. Convert the three suites to the shared `createTests` harness and add scenario-specific history assertions so they run locally and in cloud integration, as required by the project testing rules.
